description: Readiness for Investment in Sustainable Energy is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Environment, Policies and plans", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). Readiness for Investment in Sustainable Energy (RISE) is a suite of indicators that assesses the legal and regulatory environment for investment in sustainable energy. This dataset contains scores for every single indicator of RISE for each country. Coverage: 17 countries in East Asia and the Pacific. It has 1 file. The portal files it under Environment, Policies and plans. The portal gives 2014 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
